name: Brightwater Family Dental
description: General and family dental care for adults and children: check-ups, fillings, crowns, root canals and whitening, with same-day emergency appointments when we have space.

services.name: Check-ups and cleaning
services.summary: An exam with the dentist, X-rays when needed, and a clean with our hygienist.

services.name: Children's dentistry
services.summary: Check-ups and fillings for children from their first tooth onwards.

services.name: Fillings
services.summary: Tooth-colored fillings for cavities and chipped teeth.

services.name: Crowns and bridges
services.summary: Crowns to protect weak or broken teeth, and bridges to replace a missing tooth.

services.name: Root canal treatment
services.summary: Treatment for an infected or badly inflamed tooth, so it can be kept.

services.name: Teeth whitening
services.summary: In-office whitening, or custom trays to whiten at home.

services.name: Emergency appointments
services.summary: Same-day appointments for toothache, swelling and broken teeth when we have space.

facts.emergency: Toothache, swelling or a broken tooth? Call before 10am and we will try to see you the same day.

bring: Your dental insurance card, if you have one
A list of the medicines you take
new_patients.forms: We email new patient forms when you book. You can also fill them in at reception; please arrive 15 minutes early if you do.
new_patients.first_visit: Allow about an hour for your first visit.

facts.insurance_note: We accept most PPO dental plans. Call us with your plan name and we will check your cover before your visit.
facts.payment: We take credit and debit cards, cash, and HSA and FSA cards.
facts.accessibility: Step-free entrance and an accessible restroom. Street parking on SE Alder Street and a bike rack outside.
